production_page.caption: MANUFACTURING
production_page.subtitle: of boiler houses under factory conditions
production_page.adv_subtitle: For modular block boiler houses, factory assembly is a key argument in favor of reliability and speed
production_page.adv_item1: Continuous quality control of workmanship: welds, joints, and connections
production_page.adv_item2: Assembly is carried out in optimal controlled conditions, eliminating corrosive weather effects on construction and installation
production_page.adv_item3: Compact technical solutions: simplified site selection for the placement and operation of hazardous production facilities
production_page.adv_item4: Rapid erection speed of the boiler house at the customer's site
production_page.adv_item5: Simplified logistics (especially critical for remote and hard-to-reach areas)
